title: Conditional κ = 0.001266564732900111: seven-replica whole-residual hosting
body:
Conditional candidate **κ = 0.001266564732900111**, **0.0022568854297536104% above PR454** at `d14eb0dd425bd681e3b43f208d089e679d600176`. Complex binds. Submitted as a draft before the full replay, as requested; full verification and CI are pending.

Pool seven replicas of PR454's eleven-stage complex supplier to remove an integer packing remainder. Every one of the43,120 rank9 helper residuals remains whole on a single physical family;35,840 use an owner in another replica. The local word, all phases and the bit supplier are unchanged. Complex lower is `634085476752554528491/500000000000000000000000`, with8,400live/8,978physical families.

This does **not** use PR448's cross-family residual split. I reproduced PR451's trace obstruction and corrected our PR453's title/body to withdraw its established-gain claim. The previous pooled56 score is affected too. Here whole-family relocation is an ordinary family permutation followed by the owner's coordinate basis; the proof explicitly retains PR442's complete-call correlated dirty-helper contract and allows the owner replica to differ. The invoice charges an additional family-routing factor.

Changed-component checks passed: all43,120owners and idle remainders;1,913,989emitted events;8,520exact phase equalities;1,320routes;24omitted-bridge controls;19mutations; exact whole-family physical routing controls that reject splitting; both rational moment engines; fresh complex invoice; six bootstrap steps and all47strict outer inequalities with next-grid and parameter controls. The one-replica screen exactly reproduces PR454. Larger13/15/17stage screens were worse.

The early component invoice cites the pinned, unchanged PR454 bit supplier; it is not a fresh full-parent receipt. A fresh fullPR454 chain is running locally. Initial attempts exposed PR436's unquoted paths and a missing NumPy dependency; failures are retained. The package includes a documented external shell adapter for SSD paths containing spaces, with pinned source files unchanged.

Reproduce: `python -B research/e8-whole-replica7/verify.py /absolute/new/output`. Default runs the fullPR454 chain with phase regeneration. `--parent-output` explicitly reuses an existing full receipt and emits a distinct component-reuse status. See `research/e8-whole-replica7/PROOF.md` for the argument and scope.

All inherited compiler, restored-work, compressed-window, tape/common-grid, precision, row and analytic assumptions remain. No unconditional multiplication theorem or Lean proof is claimed.

Credits: chafreaky with OpenAI Codex assistance (PR451/454 templates, audits, source pins and cross-family obstruction); DaysSky (PR442 hosting), icekylinx (PR433), Zhihao Chen and all inherited contributors. Seven-replica selection/composition by Rohan Arun with OpenAI Codex assistance. Licenses, notices and source pins retained. This branch starts from the pinnedPR454 head so its unchanged supplier packages remain directly reproducible.

Concurrent work: [PR455](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/455), read after this submission, independently uses whole-residual pooling with eight replicas and a bit-program portfolio. Its reportedκ0.001266541949425315 is below this seven-replica candidate by 0.001798872%. No exclusive discovery or priority claim is made. A tighter solver follow-up gives the same normalized endpoint at7,14,21,35and56replicas; these are scoped searches, not a global optimality theorem.
